items.text: The role of teachers in career guidance is to widen students' awareness, notice interests and strengths in daily work, share reliable information, connect students with outside people and refer sensitive or complex cases, without predicting futures or pushing their own choices.
Teachers add most value by asking good questions, curating accurate information and linking students to real people, not by deciding for them.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
